_readme: Advisories the dependency audit may pass over. Every entry needs: advisory, package, scope (production or development), path, reason, owner (accountable person), approvedBy, status 'approved', expires (date) and reviewBy (date, before expiry). 'proposed' entries never pass in CI; local evidence runs may pass them with --allow-proposed and say so. The file is protected by .github/CODEOWNERS (enforcement pending GitHub configuration).
